questions.question: A sum of Rs. 15,000 invested at compound interest (compounding annually) at the rate of 12% per annum for 2 years. Find the compound interest.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = Rs. 15,000

Rate (R) = 12% per annum

Time (T) = 2 years

**Formula Used:**

Compound Interest (CI) = P(1 + R/100)T - P

**Calculation:**

CI = 15000(1 + 12/100)² - 15000

CI = 15000(1 + 0.12)² - 15000

CI = 15000(1.12)² - 15000

CI = 15000 × 1.2544 - 15000

CI = 18816 - 15000

CI = 3816

**The compound interest is Rs. 3816.**

questions.question: Average of 12 numbers is 60. If 12 is subtracted from the first five numbers and 10 is added in the next seven numbers, then what will be the new average?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Average of 12 numbers = 60

12 is subtracted from the first five numbers

10 is added to the next seven numbers

**Formula Used:**

New average = (Sum of new numbers) / Total numbers

**Calculation:**

Sum of 12 numbers = 60 × 12

Sum of 12 numbers = 720

Sum of first five numbers after subtracting 12 from each:

Sum of first five numbers = x

Sum of first five numbers after subtraction = x - (12 × 5)

Sum of first five numbers after subtraction = x - 60

Sum of next seven numbers after adding 10 to each:

Sum of next seven numbers = 720 - x

Sum of next seven numbers after addition = (720 - x) + (10 × 7)

Sum of next seven numbers after addition = (720 - x) + 70

New sum of 12 numbers:

New sum = (x - 60) + (720 - x + 70)

New sum = x - 60 + 720 - x + 70

New sum = 730

New average:

New average = 730 / 12

⇒ New average = 60.83

**The new average is 60.83.**

questions.question: If 35 percent of P = 60 percent of Q and Q is (z/3) percent of P, then what is the value of z?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of Q to P → Q / P = 35% ÷ 60% = 7 / 12

Given Q is (z/3)% of P → Q / P = z / 300

Equating both values → z / 300 = 7 / 12

z = (300 × 7) ÷ 12 = 175

**∴ The correct answer is 175.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

35% of P = 60% of Q

Q = (z/3)% of P

 
• 
 
 
 P (12 parts)
 
 
 Q (7 parts)
 
 

 Q / P = 7 / 12
 
 35% P = 60% Q
 
 Q = (z/3)% of P → z = 300 × (7/12) = 175

**Calculations:**

⇒ (35 / 100) × P = (60 / 100) × Q

⇒ 35P = 60Q

⇒ Q / P = 35 / 60

⇒ Q / P = 7 / 12

According to the second condition:

⇒ Q = (z / 3)% of P

⇒ Q = [z ÷ (3 × 100)] × P

⇒ Q / P = z / 300

Equating the two values of Q / P:

⇒ z / 300 = 7 / 12

⇒ z = (7 × 300) ÷ 12

⇒ z = 2100 ÷ 12

⇒ z = 175

**∴ The correct answer is 175.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Percentage to Ratio Conversion

To convert a percentage into a fraction or ratio, strictly divide the given percentage value by 100 and simplify. Example: x% = x/100.

Percentage Equivalence

If A% of B = C% of D, then the ratio of B to D is inversely proportional to their respective percentage coefficients. Thus, B/D = C/A.

A is x% of B

This relationship easily translates to the algebraic form A = (x/100) × B, allowing direct calculation for any missing parameter.

questions.question: What is the value of (0.5 div(0.5 times 0.5))/((0.5 div 0.5) times 0.5)?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The expression to evaluate is:

(0.5 div(0.5 times 0.5))/((0.5 div 0.5) times 0.5)

**Calculation:**

Let's simplify the expression step by step.

**Numerator:**

0.5 ÷ (0.5 × 0.5)

= 0.5 ÷ 0.25

= 2

**Denominator:**

(0.5 ÷ 0.5) × 0.5

= 1 × 0.5

= 0.5

Now, divide the numerator by the denominator:

2 ÷ 0.5 = 4

**∴ The value of the expression is 4.**

questions.question: What is the value of 49 × 4 ÷ 28 + 56 ÷ 7 × 8 - 784 ÷ 28 + 14 × 2?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

49 × 4 ÷ 28 + 56 ÷ 7 × 8 - 784 ÷ 28 + 14 × 2

**Formula Used:**

Follow the BODMAS/BIDMAS rule (Brackets, Orders (i.e. powers and square roots, etc.), Division and Multiplication, Addition and Subtraction)

**Calculation:**

⇒ 49 × 4 ÷ 28 + 56 ÷ 7 × 8 - 784 ÷ 28 + 14 × 2

First, perform the multiplications and divisions from left to right:

⇒ (49 × 4) ÷ 28 + (56 ÷ 7) × 8 - 784 ÷ 28 + 14 × 2

⇒ 196 ÷ 28 + 8 × 8 - 784 ÷ 28 + 14 × 2

⇒ 7 + 64 - 28 + 28

Next, perform the additions and subtractions from left to right:

⇒ 7 + 64 = 71

⇒ 71 - 28 = 43

⇒ 43 + 28 = 71

**The correct answer is option 1**

questions.question: The average age of 19 students of a class is 22 years. If a new student of age 42 years joins the class, then what will be the average age of these 20 students?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Average age of 19 students = 22 years.

Age of the new student = 42 years.

**Formula Used:**

New average age = (Total age of existing students + Age of new student) / Total number of students

**Calculation:**

Total age of 19 students = 19 × 22

Total age of 19 students = 418 years

Total age of 20 students = 418 + 42

Total age of 20 students = 460 years

New average age = 460 / 20

New average age = 23 years

**The new average age of these 20 students is 23 years.**

questions.question: Dinesh alone can do a work in 96 hours. Dinesh and Rahul together can do the same work in 48 hours. Rahul and Tarun together can do the same work in 16 hours. In how many hours can Tarun alone do the same work?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Dinesh alone can do a work in 96 hours.

Dinesh and Rahul together can do the same work in 48 hours.

Rahul and Tarun together can do the same work in 16 hours.

**Formula Used:**

Work Rate = 1 / Time

If A and B work together: Work Rate꜀ₒₘbᵢₙₑd = Work RateA + Work RateB

**Calculation:**

Let the total work be W.

Work Rate of Dinesh = 1 / 96

Work Rate of Dinesh and Rahul together = 1 / 48

Work Rate of Rahul and Tarun together = 1 / 16

Work Rate of Rahul = Work Rate of Dinesh and Rahul together - Work Rate of Dinesh

⇒ Work Rate of Rahul = 1 / 48 - 1 / 96

⇒ Work Rate of Rahul = (2 - 1) / 96

⇒ Work Rate of Rahul = 1 / 96

Work Rate of Tarun = Work Rate of Rahul and Tarun together - Work Rate of Rahul

⇒ Work Rate of Tarun = 1 / 16 - 1 / 96

⇒ Work Rate of Tarun = (6 - 1) / 96

⇒ Work Rate of Tarun = 5 / 96

Time taken by Tarun to complete the work alone = 1 / Work Rate of Tarun

⇒ Time = 96 / 5

⇒ Time = 19.2 hours

**Tarun alone can do the same work in 19.2 hours.**

questions.question: After a discount of 28 percent an article is sold for Rs. 1008. What is the marked price of the article?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Discount = 28%

Selling Price after discount = Rs. 1008

**Formula Used:**

Marked Price = Selling Price / (1 - Discount Rate)

**Calculation:**

Let the Marked Price be M.

Discount Rate = 28% = 0.28

Selling Price = Marked Price × (1 - Discount Rate)

1008 = M × (1 - 0.28)

1008 = M × 0.72

⇒ M = 1008 / 0.72

⇒ M = 1400

**The marked price of the article is Rs. 1400.**

questions.question: A car left 42 minutes early than the scheduled time but in order to reach its destination 210 km away in time, it had to slow its usual speed by 10 km/hr. What is the usual speed of the car?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Distance to destination = 210 km

Time left early = 42 minutes = 42/60 hours = 0.7 hours

Reduction in speed = 10 km/hr

**Formula Used:**

Let the usual speed of the car be x km/hr.

Time = Distance / Speed

**Calculation:**

Let usual speed of car be ‘x’ km/hr,

A car left 42 minutes early than the scheduled time and in order to reach the destination 210 km away in time, it has to slow its speed by 10 km/hr from the usual,

⇒ 210/ (x – 10) – 210/x = 42/60

⇒ 210 × [1/ (x – 10) – 1/x] = 7/10

⇒ 30 × [(x - x + 10)/(x² - 10x)] = 1/10

⇒ 10/(x² - 10x) = 1/300

⇒ 3000 = x² - 10x

⇒ x2 - 10x - 3000 = 0

⇒ x2 - 60x + 50x - 3000 = 0

⇒ x(x - 60) + 50(x - 60) = 0

⇒ (x - 60)(x + 50) = 0

⇒ x = 60 or -50

Since speed cannot be negative, so

∴ Usual speed of car, x = 60 km/hr

questions.question: If P percent of P is 225, then what is the value of p²?

questions.question: In a mixture of 110 litre the ratio of water and milk is 4 ∶ 7 respectively. How much water must be added to make the ratio of water and milk as 8 ∶ 7 respectively?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Total mixture = 110 litres

Ratio of water to milk = 4 : 7

Desired ratio of water to milk = 8 : 7

**Formula Used:**

Let the initial quantity of water be W and the initial quantity of milk be M.

Ratio formula: (W)/(M) = (4)/(7) 

New ratio formula: (W + x)/(M) = (8)/(7) 

**Calculation:**

Initial quantity of water (W) = (4)/(11) times 110 

W = 40 litres

Initial quantity of milk (M) = (7)/(11) times 110 

M = 70 litres

We need to find the amount of water (x) to be added to make the new ratio 8 : 7.

Using the new ratio formula:

 (40 + x)/(70) = (8)/(7) 

Cross-multiplying:

⇒ 7(40 + x) = 8 times 70 

⇒ 280 + 7x = 560

⇒ 7x = 280

⇒ x = 40

**The amount of water to be added is 40 litres.**

questions.question: If an article is sold at a loss of 20 percent, then what is the respective ratio of cost price and selling price of the article?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Loss = 20%

**Formula Used:**

Selling Price (SP) = Cost Price (CP) - (Loss% of CP)

Ratio = CP : SP

**Calculation:**

Let CP = 100 (Assumption for ease of calculation)

Loss = 20% of CP

Loss = 20% of 100

Loss = 20

SP = CP - Loss

⇒ SP = 100 - 20

⇒ SP = 80

Ratio (CP : SP) = 100 : 80

Ratio (CP : SP) = 5 : 4

**The respective ratio of cost price and selling price of the article is 5 : 4.**

questions.question: 22 men can make a wall in 2 days. How many men are required to complete the same work in half a day?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

22 men can make a wall in 2 days.

**Formula Used:**

Work = Men × Time

**Calculation:**

Work done by 22 men in 2 days:

Work = 22 men × 2 days

Work = 44 man-days

Let *x* be the number of men required to complete the same work in half a day.

Work = *x* men × 0.5 days

Since the work done is the same:

44 man-days = *x* men × 0.5 days

⇒ *x* = 44 / 0.5

⇒ *x* = 88

**The number of men required to complete the same work in half a day is 88.**

questions.question: If 4T = 5U, then what is the value of (T + U) / T ?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

4T = 5U

**Formula Used:**

(T + U) / T

**Calculation:**

From the given equation:

4T = 5U

⇒ T = 5U / 4

Now, we need to find (T + U) / T

⇒ (T + U) / T = (5U/4 + U) / (5U/4)

⇒ (5U/4 + 4U/4) / (5U/4)

⇒ (9U/4) / (5U/4)

⇒ 9/5

The value of (T + U) / T is 9/5.

questions.question: Find the sides of an equilateral triangle whose area is 16√3 cm².
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Area of an equilateral triangle = 16√3 cm²

**Formula Used:**

Area of an equilateral triangle = ( sqrt{3}/4 ) × side²

**Calculation:**

Let the side of the equilateral triangle be a cm.

Area = ( sqrt{3}/4 ) × a²

Given Area = 16√3 cm²

⇒ ( sqrt{3}/4 ) × a² = 16√3

⇒ a² = (16√3 × 4) / √3

⇒ a² = 64

⇒ a = √64

⇒ a = 8 cm

**The sides of the equilateral triangle are 8 cm.**

questions.question: A certain sum of money becomes 3.5 times of itself in 14 years at a rate of simple interest. In 28 years, that amount it will become how many times of itself at the same rate of simple interest?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A certain sum of money becomes 3.5 times of itself in 14 years at a rate of simple interest.

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = Principal (P) × Rate (R) × Time (T) / 100

Final Amount (A) = Principal (P) + Simple Interest (SI)

For the given problem, Final Amount (A) = 3.5 × Principal (P)

**Calculation:**

Let the Principal be P.

According to the problem,

3.5P = P + (P × R × 14) / 100

⇒ 3.5P = P + 14PR / 100

⇒ 3.5P - P = 14PR / 100

⇒ 2.5P = 14PR / 100

⇒ 2.5 × 100 = 14R

⇒ 250 = 14R

⇒ R = 250 / 14

⇒ R ≈ 17.86%

Now, for 28 years,

Final Amount (A) = P + (P × R × 28) / 100

⇒ A = P + (P × 17.86 × 28) / 100

⇒ A = P + (P × 500.08) / 100

⇒ A = P + 5P

⇒ A = 6P

**In 28 years, the amount will become 6 times of itself.**

questions.question: What is the value of 4500 ÷ 9 + 1800 × 2 - 310 × 7?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

4500 ÷ 9 + 1800 × 2 - 310 × 7

**Formula Used:**

Use BODMAS/BIDMAS rules to solve the expression: Brackets, Orders (i.e. powers and square roots, etc.), Division and Multiplication, Addition and Subtraction.

**Calculation:**

First, solve the division:

4500 ÷ 9 ⇒ 500

Then, solve the multiplications:

1800 × 2 ⇒ 3600

310 × 7 ⇒ 2170

Now, perform the addition and subtraction:

500 + 3600 - 2170

⇒ 4100 - 2170

⇒ 1930

**The value of the expression is 1930.**
